choose.when: SELECT profile_id AS entityId, user_id AS ownerUserId, profile_image_path AS storedPath, visibility, status FROM member_profile WHERE profile_id = #{entityId}
SELECT team_id AS entityId, leader_user_id AS ownerUserId, representative_image_path AS storedPath, 'PUBLIC' AS visibility, status FROM team WHERE team_id = #{entityId}

SELECT wi.board_post_id AS entityId, p.author_user_id AS ownerUserId, wi.representative_image_path AS storedPath, p.visibility, p.status FROM work_item wi JOIN board_post p ON p.post_id = wi.board_post_id WHERE wi.board_post_id = #{entityId} AND wi.status = 'PUBLISHED'

SELECT pi.portfolio_item_id AS entityId, mp.user_id AS ownerUserId, pi.thumbnail_image_path AS storedPath, mp.visibility, pi.status FROM portfolio_item pi JOIN member_profile mp ON mp.profile_id = pi.profile_id WHERE pi.portfolio_item_id = #{entityId} AND mp.status = 'ACTIVE'

SELECT contest_id AS entityId, COALESCE(requester_company_user_id, created_by) AS ownerUserId, representative_image_path AS storedPath, 'PUBLIC' AS visibility, status FROM contest WHERE contest_id = #{entityId}
SELECT request_id AS entityId, requester_user_id AS ownerUserId, representative_image_path AS storedPath, 'PRIVATE' AS visibility, status FROM contest_open_request WHERE request_id = #{entityId}
choose.otherwise: SELECT NULL AS entityId, NULL AS ownerUserId, NULL AS storedPath, 'PRIVATE' AS visibility, 'DELETED' AS status WHERE 1 = 0

choose.when: UPDATE member_profile SET profile_image_path = #{storedPath}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE profile_id = #{entityId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
UPDATE team SET representative_image_path = #{storedPath}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE team_id = #{entityId} AND status != 'DELETED'
UPDATE work_item SET representative_image_path = #{storedPath}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE board_post_id = #{entityId} AND status = 'PUBLISHED'
UPDATE portfolio_item SET thumbnail_image_path = #{storedPath}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE portfolio_item_id = #{entityId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
UPDATE contest SET representative_image_path = #{storedPath}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE contest_id = #{entityId}
UPDATE contest_open_request SET representative_image_path = #{storedPath}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE request_id = #{entityId}
choose.otherwise: UPDATE contest_open_request SET request_id = request_id WHERE 1 = 0
